steps.label: Pack
steps.run: mkdir -p frames && rm -rf ct tex && cp -R "$HOME/ShortsRenderAgent/repo/packs/ct5/ct" "$HOME/ShortsRenderAgent/repo/packs/ct5/tex" . && ls ct

steps.label: Szene bauen
steps.run: CT_ROOT=$PWD /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ct/scene.py > build.log 2>&1; grep -v -i -E 'bearer|api_key|deprecat|use_nodes' build.log | tail -20; grep -q 'SCENE OK' build.log && cp ct/proj.json proj.txt

steps.label: Vollrender EEVEE
steps.run: CT_ROOT=$PWD /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ct/scene.blend -P ct/render.py -- seq $PWD/frames 14 eevee > render.log 2>&1; tail -3 render.log; ls frames | wc -l

steps.label: Packen
steps.run: cd frames && zip -q -0 ../ct5_frames.zip f*.jpg; cd ..; ls -la ct5_frames.zip proj.txt
